purpose: Noncommercial retrospective next-view-basket retrieval baseline; no conversion, revenue, causal or serving claim

algorithm.statistic: count_i = number of canonical qualified view event rows for item i in the fixed fit interval; each row contributes integer 1
algorithm.weighting: one per canonical view event; no cart/transaction weights, quantities, per-visitor deduplication, time decay or event caps
algorithm.filtering: no full-period k-core, activity/bot deletion, support-based item removal or test-dependent eligibility
algorithm.fit_artifact: one row per item with strictly positive fit count; integer count and fit interval/source hashes recorded; missing lookup is exactly zero
algorithm.independent_count_audit: separate count reconstruction is an acceptance oracle, not another primary fit, candidate or tuning trial; log both operations distinctly
algorithm.training_query_scoring: disabled in v1; no training resubstitution score presented as temporal validation
algorithm.random_seeds: not applicable to deterministic P0; parent five seeds remain required for future stochastic algorithms

ranking_and_fallback.candidate_source: catalog.csv filtered first_view_ms < query_ms; all candidates retained including warmup-only, new and previously viewed items
ranking_and_fallback.catalog_clock: causal prefix may grow during a role; frozen popularity statistics do not update
ranking_and_fallback.unknown_visitor: same P0 ranking over the same causal catalog; no visitor fit or population exclusion
ranking_and_fallback.unknown_item: keep candidate with integer score 0; sort by numeric itemid among score ties
ranking_and_fallback.empty_statistics: all eligible candidates score 0 and use numeric itemid order; report explicit all-zero-fit diagnostic, no silent algorithm substitution
ranking_and_fallback.empty_catalog: empty ranking, zero retrieval metrics for nonempty target; query remains in main denominator
ranking_and_fallback.short_catalog: return min(10, candidate_count) unique IDs; no padding, repeated IDs or out-of-catalog fillers
ranking_and_fallback.full_candidate_meaning: exact top K in the total order over the entire causal catalog; no evaluation negative sampling or target-based candidate injection
ranking_and_fallback.exact_optimization: cached sorted positive-count IDs plus sorted zero-count candidates may avoid dense query-item enumeration only if exact full-catalog top-K equivalence and candidate counts are verified
ranking_and_fallback.invalid_prediction: duplicate/noncandidate IDs, wrong list length, nonfinite/noninteger counts, order or fit identity mismatch stop acceptance; never omit affected query

evaluation.eligible_filter: exact role equality only; all source queries in that role already have status=labelled
evaluation.query_identity: bind complete queries.csv bytes and exact role filter; unique keys and exact expected count required; no missing/extra keys
evaluation.target: complete unique target_items set from the accepted dataset, even if some items are absent from candidate catalog
evaluation.dcg: sum over ranks r=1..len(top10) of 1[predicted_item_r in full_target_set] / log2(r+1)
evaluation.idcg: sum over r=1..min(10, full_target_count) of 1/log2(r+1); unreachable targets remain in full_target_count
evaluation.ndcg: DCG / IDCG for each nonempty target; arithmetic mean over every eligible query
evaluation.recall: unique top10 target hits / full_target_count; query macro
evaluation.hit_rate: 1 if at least one top10 hit else 0; query macro
evaluation.mrr: 1/rank of first top10 target hit else 0; query macro
evaluation.visitor_macro_ndcg: mean query NDCG within each anonymous visitor, then equal-weight mean over visitors; separate from query macro
evaluation.catalog_coverage: unique recommended IDs / union of causal candidate IDs over all eligible queries; report numerator and denominator; prefix union can use first_view_ms < max(query_ms)
evaluation.unreachable_target_policy: retain full target, query and visitor in unconditional denominator; missing targets earn no hit
evaluation.conditional_metrics: separate subgroup with full_target_set subset of causal_catalog; keep same formulas/full target and report subgroup query/visitor/target denominators; never replace unconditional primary result
structural_coverage: reachable target occurrences / full target occurrences
evaluation.metric_undefined: zero queries => null metrics with zero-query reason; nonempty query with empty catalog => zero retrieval metrics; zero catalog union => null catalog coverage
evaluation.invalid_dataset: empty or repeated target IDs, wrong role/status, boundary/maturity mismatch, malformed key or changed source stops run; never redefine denominator to proceed

precision.nan_or_infinity: forbidden; undefined cases use null and reason

evaluation.confidence_intervals: none in P0 v1; descriptive metrics only; future inferential comparisons must resample visitor clusters under a separate frozen comparison plan

fixed_denominators_from_accepted_build.interpretation: copied from prior independently accepted dataset aggregates; not newly computed model scores or newly parsed test labels

membership: visitor_seen_before_fit true/false from accepted diagnostic at the appropriate fit cutoff
current basket size one/multiple via exact basket key join
train_view_events fixed original train-only activity groups 0, 1, 2-5, 6+
target model coverage: all positive-fit-count targets / mixed positive-and-zero targets / all zero-count targets
slices.model_item_coverage: derive from actual frozen positive count table; targets_seen_before_fit and new_to_fit_targets from builder are historical prefix diagnostics, not model item coverage
slices.support_floor: max(50, ceil(role_unconditional_query_count / 100)); use query count and separately report unique visitors/target occurrences
slices.empty_slice: n=0 => null metric, empty status, no stability claim
slices.small_nonempty_slice: 0<n<floor => descriptive_only; do not merge, discard, tune or declare stable to pass
slices.known_small_groups: validation current/target multi-item groups 56/53 <1669; reserved-test groups 33/29 <921; original training 199/192 <6427 retained as dataset limitations
slices.query_dependence: repeated queries from one visitor are dependent; counts are not independent sample size or evidence of business lift

requirements: unchanged accepted dataset, data contract and this protocol hashes
implemented baseline and evaluator frozen with code/environment/source hashes
synthetic hand-counted metrics and boundary/future-injection counterexamples passed
one development fit and full validation denominator/ranking/metrics independent readback accepted; all results and sparse slices retained regardless of score
validation acceptance, sole P0 algorithm and exact implementation frozen before final refit
one separate train+validation final refit and independent count audit accepted and artifact hash fixed before first test rank
later explicit request to execute reserved retrospective test; current specification task does not activate it
exclusive durable test usage identity/state written before first test-query ranking
reserved_test_gate.performance_gate_rule: validation score level or improvement is not an activation condition; technical/protocol acceptance only
reserved_test_gate.after_start: mark test used before ranking; freeze identity, attempt count and chunk progress; partial failure cannot reset gate or justify tuning
reserved_test_gate.same_identity_resume: only exact same dataset/protocol/code/environment/final-fit/query identities may resume technical failure; preserve partial outputs and attempts; no new fit, settings, candidate or repeated metric-based selection
reserved_test_gate.after_observation: report complete result including poor scores and small groups; no tuning on this reserved test; substantive changes require new protocol and new reserved evaluation evidence
reserved_test_gate.source_exposure: full dataset structure and labels have already been read for builder acceptance; no recommendation rankings/metrics yet; test is retrospective reserved evaluation, not pristine unseen data

required: integer item_counts.csv with fit audit and source-role reconciliation
every-query ordered top10 IDs/scores, candidate count and fit identity
every-query hit/DCG/IDCG/metric terms and full target/reachability counts
query/visitor macro, catalog union and slice aggregates with explicit denominators/null reasons/support flags
independent training count, exact full-candidate ranking and metric recomputation through all output rows
separate primary-fit and independent-audit counters plus durable test state
planned_artifacts_and_acceptance.independent_oracle: separate accepted-source parser and integer counts; independent exact ranking oracle and metric formula implementation; full output identity/order/value readback, not selected-query spot checks
planned_artifacts_and_acceptance.optimization_proof: if cached full-order ranks are reused, independent oracle must establish their equivalence for every query candidate set; synthetic cases include future-high-count items, zero-count ties, short/empty catalogs and unreachable targets
planned_artifacts_and_acceptance.reentry: complete artifacts verify only; partial artifacts preserved; no silent overwrite or evidence regeneration
planned_artifacts_and_acceptance.publication: public code/specification/aggregate evidence only; raw data, per-query/item/visitor artifacts, models and credentials remain Git ignored inside shop

limitations: anonymous visitor keys are not verified people
event-time retrospective reconstruction lacks ingestion/revision completeness evidence
no exposure/propensity or verified continuous inventory; no causal, revenue or conversion conclusion
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 noncommercial attribution and applicable share-alike conditions retained; commercial deployment rights not established
multi-item groups remain under support floor; original Olist/UCI small-group and retrospective restrictions remain unchanged
change_control: preserve parent data contract/dataset and this protocol; new algorithms, fitting units/windows, catalog, metrics, denominators or gating policy require a new protocol version before their execution; current progress belongs in new receipts and README, not edits to frozen v1
